title: Ghost Signal
subtitle: Capture the Pact listening post
briefing: Since Halvik the rivers have frozen overnight and blizzards have come out of clear skies - always just ahead of a Pact offensive. Our scientists say weather does not behave like this. Something is making it happen.
Signals intelligence has traced a coded transmission to a Pact listening post deep in the Sorel Forest. It relays telemetry to something called AURORA. We need that data.
Captain Reyes will lead a small strike team. Engineers must capture the post intact - do not destroy it. Once it is ours, hold it while the data uploads. Reyes is to come home alive.
victory_text: The Aurora telemetry has been captured. And with it, a message nobody expected.

objectives.text: Capture the Listening Post with an Engineer.
Hold the Listening Post until the data upload completes.

lines.speaker: Capt. Jonah Reyes
lines.text: Strike team ready. Rangers up front - they can drop a man before he sees us. Keep the Engineers in the back.

lines.speaker: Lt. Sarah Okafor
lines.text: Remember, Commander: we need that post intact. Don't shoot it - walk an Engineer inside.

lines.speaker: Capt. Jonah Reyes
lines.text: Flame bunker in the clearing. Snipers first, then rush the rocket man.

lines.speaker: Lt. Sarah Okafor
lines.text: The post is north-east of the bridge. Expect a garrison and a flak gun - good thing we didn't bring aircraft.

lines.speaker: Lt. Sarah Okafor
lines.text: We're in! Upload started - two and a half minutes. The post's radar is ours too.

lines.speaker: Capt. Jonah Reyes
lines.text: And here comes the neighbourhood. Dig in!

lines.speaker: Unknown woman (encrypted)
lines.text: ...if anyone in the Concord can hear this. My name is Doctor Ilse Varga. I designed Aurora.

lines.speaker: Dr. Ilse Varga (encrypted)
lines.text: It is not a defensive system. Vasko means to freeze half the continent. I can help you stop it. Station Nine. Please... hurry.

shots.speaker: Lt. Sarah Okafor
shots.text: That's the listening post. It's been transmitting the same burst every eleven minutes - straight into the Arctic.

shots.speaker: Capt. Jonah Reyes
shots.text: Quiet in, quiet out. We take the post, we take the data, we go home for Christmas.

shots.speaker: Lt. Sarah Okafor
shots.text: Upload complete. Commander... the telemetry is targeting data. Coordinates for every major city west of the Varn. With weather models.

shots.speaker: Gen. Adrian Hale
shots.text: A machine that makes winter. God help us. Find out where Station Nine is, Lieutenant. If Doctor Varga is real, we are going to get her out.
